// Fixture — should be flagged.
//
// Two violations expected: isValidID and isValidSlug both at
// package-private scope, both without the opt-out pragma.

package fixture

func isValidID(id string) bool { return id != "" }

func isValidSlug(slug string) bool { return slug != "" }
